summary: Candidate is a distinct macro_protocol for notebook-based integration testing of LLM providers in CI/CD pipelines. It differs semantically and operationally from existing skills (model evaluation benchmarks, training pipelines) which focus on model performance assessment and training, not provider integration validation. The peer_candidates (singleton client initialization, import interception, crew execution) operate at different task families (client_lifecycle_management, observability_instrumentation, agent_orchestration) and stages. No existing skill covers automated notebook execution for provider integration testing across multiple Python versions.
